text:
Nina: Short proposal to tighten postmortem follow-ups. Problem: actions drift. Proposal: 72h owner assign, Sev1/2 close target 14d, Sev3 30d, small-change fast-path 7d. Require verifier separate from implementer. Weekly 15-min closure pulse. IC rotation aligned weekly to oncall.

Omar: keep it light or teams will ignore. Small-change fast-path helps.

Priya: Add mandatory backup on assignment; ops-bot pings backup after 48h if no update, escalate at 72h.

Zoe: Ops-bot: can you auto-tag recurrence if action links prior incidents?

ops-bot: yes, I can apply recurrence label and compute a simple score (refs in 90d *2 + refs in 90-365d). Tag >=3 high. Will post Monday digest 09:00.

Nina: Jira template snippet for actions: Action / Owner / Backup / Severity / Due / Verifier / Verification notes / Recurrence_tag / small_change. ops-bot will lint tickets and nudge missing fields.

Priya: Pilot: 2 sprints, weekly pulse starts next Monday, 60-day retro.

Omar: I'll prototype the Jira fields + saved filter and share by EOD Friday.

Nina: Thanks—I'll make the parent rollout ticket and schedule the retro.

ops-bot: Draft cron job created (private).
